resources.string: Preparing clear voice for another meeting…

Recap removes background noise from this meeting\'s audio, on your phone, and saves the result beside the original recording, which is not changed. Nothing leaves the phone.\n\nYou can switch between the two in the player, and delete the copy at any time. Denoising can make some sounds clipped or muffled, so the transcript is never made from the copy unless you choose it.
This meeting is %1$s long, so the copy can take a while. It keeps going if you leave this screen, and plugging the phone in saves battery.
The part made so far is deleted. The original recording is not affected.
Deletes this meeting\'s clear-voice copy and frees %1$s. The original recording, the transcript and everything else stay, and you can make the copy again from the player.
Clear voice is ready. Tap Clear voice in the player to switch.
Clear voice stopped. Nothing was kept.
Could not make the clear-voice copy. The original recording is unchanged.
Not enough free space for the clear-voice copy. Free some space and try again.
Clear voice stopped: Android limits how long apps may process media each day. Nothing was kept; try again later.
This meeting\'s audio was removed or replaced, so no clear-voice copy was kept.
Clear voice can be prepared once the recording has finished.
Clear voice is being prepared for another meeting. Try again when it has finished.
This meeting is being recorded, transcribed or summarized. Try again once that has finished.
Clear voice is being prepared for this meeting. Stop it from the player, or try again when it has finished.
